title: RA 9514 Means of Egress: Width, Count, and Illumination
subject: Fire Code and Life Safety

questions.stem: Under the general RA 9514 RIRR means-of-egress rule, what minimum width applies unless a specific occupancy division provides otherwise?

rationale.correct: Section 10.2.5.2 paragraph F states that the width of any means of egress shall not be less than 915 mm except when specifically provided under Divisions 8 through 20.

distractors.A: 760 mm appears in other dimensional contexts but is not this general minimum.
distractors.B: 815 mm is not the cited general egress minimum.
distractors.D: 1120 mm appears in the stair capacity equation context, not as the general minimum egress width.

rationale.takeaway: Keep the general width minimum separate from stair-capacity and occupancy-specific rules.

questions.stem: A storey has an occupant load of 750. Under the general Section 10.2.5.2 rule, how many means of egress are required unless a specific occupancy rule changes the answer?

rationale.correct: For occupant load more than 500 but not more than 1000, the means of egress must not be less than three.

distractors.A: The general rule does not allow one for this load.
distractors.B: Two is the baseline minimum, but 750 crosses the more-than-500 threshold.
distractors.D: Four is triggered for occupant load in excess of 1000.

rationale.takeaway: More than 500 up to 1000 requires at least three means of egress.

questions.stem: What minimum illumination value is stated for floors of means of egress at corridors, landings, and exit doors?

rationale.correct: Section 10.2.5.11 states that floors of means of egress shall be illuminated at all points to values not less than 10.7 lux.

distractors.A: Below the cited Fire Code illumination value.
distractors.C: A plausible lighting distractor, but not the cited egress-floor value.
distractors.D: Too high for the cited egress-floor requirement.

rationale.takeaway: For Fire Code egress illumination, the key number in this excerpt is 10.7 lux.
